values: MEDISAFE CHAIN – Component 2 AI Use Record
Project period: 12–19 October 2026 | Component: AI-based medicine risk scoring
Scope note: This is a grouped activity record reconstructed from project tasks and repository history. Prompt summaries are paraphrased; exact prompt wording and timestamps were not reconstructed.
Discussed how to organize the Component 2 medicine-risk dataset and connect its fields to the project structure.
Suggested dataset organization, field mapping, validation considerations and implementation sequence.
Selected the dataset, reviewed its fields, placed it in the project and confirmed that the data matched the Component 2 requirements.
Dataset stored in the Component 2 data directory and reviewed during preprocessing.
Requested help structuring cleaning, encoding and feature-engineering modules for medicine risk scoring.
Suggested modular preprocessing code, validation checks and candidate model features.
Reviewed the transformation rules, chose the final features and ran the preprocessing pipeline against the project dataset.
Cleaning and feature-engineering modules completed; outputs checked during model training.
Requested implementation guidance for training and evaluating a Random Forest risk model.
Suggested training structure, evaluation metrics and reproducible model settings.
Ran training, reviewed performance, retained the suitable configuration and recorded the model metrics.
Random Forest training script and metrics created.
Requested help defining the medicine-batch and risk-score data exchanged between components.
Suggested schemas, field descriptions and contract boundaries.
Confirmed the identifiers and fields with the project architecture and maintained the shared contracts in the repository.
Shared schemas and Component 1–2 / Component 2–4 contract documents created.
Requested guidance for implementing and evaluating an XGBoost risk model using the same feature pipeline.
Suggested training flow, evaluation output and compatibility with the existing preprocessing modules.
Executed training, reviewed the results and compared them with the Random Forest model.
XGBoost training script and metrics created.
Requested help comparing the trained models and selecting the best model consistently.
Suggested comparable metrics, selection logic and documentation structure.
Reviewed the reported metrics, selected the final model and retained the evaluation evidence.
Model comparison, selection record and evaluation documentation completed.
Requested guidance for adding SHAP explanations to Component 2 predictions.
Suggested explainer structure and a readable feature-contribution response format.
Integrated the explainer, checked representative predictions and decided which explanation fields to expose through the API.
SHAP explanation modules and notebook completed.
Requested support for creating the risk-scoring API, request validation and API tests.
Suggested route structure, validation rules, error handling and test cases.
Reviewed endpoint behavior, ran the test suite and corrected integration issues in the local environment.
Runnable Component 2 API and automated validation tests completed.
Requested help implementing an on-chain registry for medicine-batch risk scores.
Suggested access control, score storage, safety checks, events and contract tests.
Reviewed the Solidity logic, aligned it with the 0–100 policy, ran Hardhat tests and controlled local deployment.
Risk Registry contract, deployment workflow and contract tests completed.
Requested help summarizing evaluation results and explaining why the selected model was retained.
Suggested a structured evaluation report and clear descriptions of metrics and limitations.
Checked the reported values against generated metrics and edited the documentation for the project context.
Requested help creating a safe local deployment workflow and central Web3 configuration.
Suggested deployment guards, network checks, address validation, ABI export and readiness checks.
Ran the deployment tests, selected the local network settings and reviewed configuration changes before PR submission.
Risk Registry deployment, shared ABI and blockchain readiness workflow completed.
Requested help reading traceability batches and mapping them into Component 2 model inputs.
Suggested the blockchain client, field mapper, error handling and integration tests.
Confirmed the approved fields, ran mapper/client tests and reviewed compatibility with the Component 1 contract.
Component 1 batch reading, mapping and assessment endpoint completed.
Requested help publishing risk records and enforcing them during prescription dispensing.
Suggested unsigned transaction construction, confirmation checks, fail-closed behavior, shared ABI handling and integration tests.
Reviewed the policy boundaries, resolved merge conflicts, ran Python and Hardhat tests and coordinated interface changes with Component 4.
Publishing API, transaction confirmation and Component 2–4 contract integration completed.
Requested an evidence-based review of Components 1, 3 and 4 and their integration status.
Summarized repository modules, missing layers, test results and integration risks.
Reviewed the findings, contacted Component 4 and used the report to prioritize presentation work.
Current component status and demonstration blockers identified.
Requested guidance for starting Hardhat, deploying Component 2 and validating the active local contract.
Provided deployment steps and checks for chain ID, bytecode, address configuration and roles.
Started the node, executed the deployment and supplied the live output. The student retained control of the terminal and local accounts.
MedicineRiskRegistry deployed on chain 31337; admin and oracle roles verified.
Requested help organizing commits, running tests and preparing a pull-request description.
Suggested focused commit groups, identified stale integration artifacts and drafted the PR summary.
Approved the changes, reviewed test output, raised the PR and merged it through the team repository workflow.
Four focused commits; 66 Python tests and 48 contract tests passed before the PR.
